load_execution_trace: load an Execution Trace from a JSON or gzipped JSON file into an ExecutionTrace object
correlate_execution_trace: correlate a PyTorch Kineto trace with an Execution Trace using record function IDs
add_et_column_op_schema: add the op_schema column from Execution Trace nodes to a correlated trace dataframe
add_et_column_input_shapes: add the input_shapes column from Execution Trace nodes to a correlated trace dataframe
add_et_column_et_node_name: add the et_node_name column from Execution Trace nodes to a correlated trace dataframe
